name: gee-sentinel-function
description: Google Cloud Function Gen 2 for Sentinel-2 imagery processing with Earth Engine

scripts.deploy: gcloud run deploy get-gee-image --source . --function getGeeImage --base-image nodejs22 --region us-east1 --allow-unauthenticated  --project earth-observation-452213
scripts.deploy-qa: gcloud run deploy get-gee-image --source . --function getGeeImage --base-image nodejs22 --region us-east1 --allow-unauthenticated  --project earth-observation-452213 --set-env-vars environment=qa
